title: Ingress Certificate Expiry Watch
app: Kubernetes homelab clusters, Proxmox, Vaultwarden, Paperless-ngx, Immich, AdGuard Home, Docker, TrueNAS, and NUT metrics via APIs, logs, Telegraf, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=uptime:probe
| stats latest(tls_days_left) as tls_days_left by service
| where match(service,"ingress|traefik|nginx") AND tls_days_left>=0 AND tls_days_left<21
| sort tls_days_left
description: Uses TLS uptime probes telemetry to monitor remaining certificate runway on homelab ingress points in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for proxy certificates that will soon expire, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest TLS uptime probes data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a hourly cadence.
visualization: Ingress table of TLS days remaining.
grandmaExplanation: It frames remaining certificate runway on homelab ingress points so you can spot proxy certificates that will soon expire before it becomes annoying.
